name: Late safety car, rain, and a mandatory stop
description: A worked ScenarioScript for the PLANNED race-director layer (src/rtv/director). It rehearses the one race a strategist is worst at: a full-course yellow that lands just before the fuel window opens, weather that turns the tyre call over, and a regulation change that removes the option of staying out. Stage 5 ships the schema, the DirectorEngine protocol and the NoopDirector default -- nothing here fires until a director implementation walks the script. Loading it validates it: ScenarioScript.load('docs/director_scenario.example.json').

injections.note: Full-course yellow a third of the way round lap 3. Payload keys are the real detector's keys, so the strategist's flag_change trigger and the spotter's both fire exactly as they would for a yellow the sim threw.
Ninety session-seconds of caution, then the restart. Session seconds, not wall clock: a 4x replay must rehearse the same race.

weather_change is a director-only event type: no iRacing channel announces rain that has not arrived, so nothing deterministic can emit it (see rtv.racestate.models.EventType). Guarded by while_flag so it does not land during the caution, where nobody could react to it.

Forced pit regulation: the stop is no longer optional, so 'extend' and 'stay_out' stop being defensible answers and the strategist's decision band changes. This is the entry that makes the script worth running against an eval set.
A hazard expressed with an existing detector event type rather than a new one. The spotter needs no change to handle it, which is the whole argument for the director producing ordinary events.
